title: Pan-Seared Lamb Chops with Springy Vegetables
description: A flavorful and nutritious lamb dish that's ready in under 30 minutes. The springy vegetables add a nice crunch to the dish.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Add the skillet oil to the pan and sear the lamb chops for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the lamb chops from the pan and set aside.
Add the springy rhubarb and zesty red onion to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes or until tender.
Return the lamb chops to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the lamb chops with the springy vegetables.
